author: CODEX SOL 6.1

deepseek.timerCoverage: Fetch plus response.json until finally; request external AbortSignal is forwarded.
deepseek.fetchCatchClassification: All caught fetch exceptions become ABORTED in pinned code; do not infer timeout versus network solely from that code.

cohereQuery.delayFormula: min(500*2**(attempts-1),8000) milliseconds; with default two retries delays500,1000. Preserve exact source behavior, including requestSignal cleanup in finally after retry wait.
cohereQuery.scope: Product-internal query retries; not harness retries or ingestion embed retry policy.

productGroundingRepair.rule: One semantic repair on same evidence is product behavior; not a harness retry. Preserve failed primary and both audit receipts where observable.

outerDeadlineStatus: UNKNOWN_NO_ACCEPTED_NUMERIC_AUTHORITY_FOUND; mandatory pre-run binding; no sum of provider maxima invented as item deadline.
adjudicationDeadlineStatus: Independent reviewer deadline/recovery policy requires explicit pre-run binding; no invented value.

harness.eligibility: None under this candidate; preserve first invocation outcome. Confidence reruns and retry-until-green forbidden.
harness.sourceRetryAccounting: Network capture records each internal provider attempt including first failure, retry delay and terminal outcome; count separately from one item invocation.
harness.timeoutAction: At bound outer deadline controller aborts, terminates/reaps child, preserves partial bytes and records TIMEOUT even if product callback later produces bytes. Grace period numeric value also requires authority before execution.

failureEvidence: Append-only first-failure record survives internal retry success. Product retryable flag must not trigger a new item invocation.
